# Test fixtures

All images here are **synthetic** (generated by `make-fixtures.mjs`), not screenshots of a real app.
`generated/` is created by `npm run fixtures` and is not committed.

- `generated/habitly.zip` — recipe project with iPhone (en+de, per-locale screenshot), Android phone,
  feature graphic, Wear OS and In-App Event card decks. Mirrors the skill's example project.
